services.family-tribute.p_text.data_rete: All source materials and the final tribute are stored on encrypted, US-based servers and permanently deleted 30 days after you confirm delivery. We never share them, never train on them, and never use them for marketing without your written permission. You can request immediate deletion at any time, even before delivery.
services.family-tribute.p_text.delivery_: Standard delivery is 7–10 business days, because every tribute is human-reviewed twice for tone, accuracy, and respect. Rush delivery in 5 days is available for an additional 30% fee. We never skip the human review — it is non-negotiable for this service.
services.family-tribute.p_text.related_m: Translate the tribute for relatives who live abroad — they get to feel included in the moment.
services.family-tribute.p_text.related_v: Restore 30-year-old footage of the same person and weave it into the tribute — a complete arc.
